findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露：2023、2024、2025 年皆無單一客戶或關聯客戶群占營收超過 10%（總營收 2025 年 402,836 百萬美元）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 8 Financial Statements
findings.excerpt: Total revenues $ 307,394 $ 350,018 $ 402,836 No individual customer or groups of affiliated customers represented more than 10% of our revenues in 2023, 2024, or 2025.

findings.claim: 10-K 揭露信用風險管理：應收帳款多為無擔保，公司持續評估客戶信用、限制授信額度，一般不要求客戶提供擔保品。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 8 Financial Statements（Credit Risks）
findings.excerpt: Accounts receivable are typically unsecured and are derived from revenues earned from customers located around the world. We manage the concentration of our credit risk exposure by performing ongoing evaluations to determine customer credit and we limit the amount of credit we extend. We generally do not require collateral from our customers.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：國際營收約占 2025 年合併營收 52%，部分國家付款週期較長、信用風險與付款詐欺較高。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: International revenues accounted for approximately 52% of consolidated revenues in 2025.
